headline: This law renames a Postal Service building in Brownsville, Texas, after 1st Lieutenant Andres Zermeno.
what_it_does: It officially designates the U.S. Postal Service facility at 1535 East Los Ebanos Boulevard in Brownsville, Texas, as the 1st Lieutenant Andres Zermeno Post Office Building. The change is a name only and does not alter how the post office operates or what services it provides.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 2, 2025, and the designation took effect on that date.
